decision.memory: Pitcher Pump: manual, pumps liquid into bottles that dupes carry. The Bottle Emptier is the companion for emptying bottles into a building. Pump icon is at (0.045, 0.77). Water pool is at the bottom, about (0.45, 0.88); check that a dupe can reach it. Placement: click the icon, hover the cursor over a floor tile, confirm a WHITE ghost and 'CLICK TO BUILD', then click at the same spot. Right-click cancels. Do not click 'Select Blueprint'. Mush Bar needs Dirt 75 kg plus an undiscovered Ingredient #2, likely Water.
